VERDICT: FAIL
BASIS: SELF

The self-report describes work on the wrong problem: the task was to compute tax for the ship-to address instead of the billing address, but the agent addressed seller nexus/registration jurisdictions—a different issue. The claimed fix doesn't match the acceptance criterion (correct jurisdiction = ship-to vs. billing). The "71/71 green" claim is self-attested (SELF class) and unverified, and a passing suite doesn't confirm the specific jurisdiction defect was corrected. The reviewer note is only a WIT-class informal, unverified observation and cannot establish a PASS on its own.
